_note: f = flavor profile on a 0-10 scale in the order of _axes. spirit = base spirit used for matching. house = may be used as a fallback when an artist has no usable genre data.

drinks.name: Old Fashioned
drinks.steps: Muddle the sugar with the bitters and a splash of water. Add bourbon and a big ice cube, stir, express the orange peel over the top.

drinks.name: Manhattan
drinks.steps: Stir with ice until very cold. Strain into a chilled coupe. Drop in the cherry.

drinks.name: Negroni
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube, garnish with orange peel.

drinks.name: Boulevardier
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube, garnish with orange peel.

drinks.name: Martini
drinks.steps: Stir with ice for a long time. Strain into a frozen glass. Twist or olive, your call.

drinks.name: Vodka Martini
drinks.steps: Shake hard with ice. Strain into a frozen glass. Olive.

drinks.name: Dirty Martini
drinks.steps: Shake hard with ice. Strain. Olives on a pick.

drinks.name: Vesper
drinks.steps: Shake until ice cold, strain, add a long thin lemon peel.

drinks.name: Gimlet
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into a chilled coupe.

drinks.name: Gin and Tonic
drinks.steps: Fill a glass with ice. Gin, then tonic. Squeeze the lime in.

drinks.name: Tom Collins
drinks.steps: Shake gin, lemon and syrup with ice. Strain over fresh ice, top with soda.

drinks.name: French 75
drinks.steps: Shake gin, lemon and syrup. Strain into a flute, top with champagne.

drinks.name: Aviation
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into a coupe. It should be faintly sky colored.

drinks.name: Bee's Knees
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into a chilled coupe.

drinks.name: Last Word
drinks.steps: Equal parts. Shake with ice, strain into a coupe.

drinks.name: Corpse Reviver No. 2
drinks.steps: Rinse the glass with absinthe. Shake the rest with ice and strain in.

drinks.name: Bramble
drinks.steps: Shake gin, lemon and syrup, strain over crushed ice. Drizzle the blackberry liqueur over the top so it bleeds through.

drinks.name: Southside
drinks.steps: Shake hard with the mint and ice. Double strain.

drinks.name: Pink Gin
drinks.steps: Swirl the bitters around a glass. Add gin and ice. Stare out a window.

drinks.name: Sazerac
drinks.steps: Rinse a chilled glass with absinthe. Stir rye, sugar and bitters with ice and strain in, no ice. Express the lemon peel and discard it.

drinks.name: Whiskey Sour
drinks.steps: Shake everything without ice, then again with ice. Strain over ice and dot the bitters on the foam.

drinks.name: Paper Plane
drinks.steps: Equal parts. Shake with ice, strain into a coupe.

drinks.name: Gold Rush
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain over a large cube.

drinks.name: Mint Julep
drinks.steps: Gently press the mint with syrup. Add bourbon, pack with crushed ice, stir until the cup frosts. Big mint bouquet on top.

drinks.name: Kentucky Mule
drinks.steps: Build over ice in a mug. Lime wedge.

drinks.name: Boilermaker
drinks.steps: Shot, then beer. Or drop the shot in. Nobody here is judging.

drinks.name: Bourbon Neat
drinks.steps: Pour. Maybe one ice cube.

drinks.name: Rye on the Rocks
drinks.steps: Pour over ice. Let it sit a minute.

drinks.name: Penicillin
drinks.steps: Shake the blended scotch, lemon and syrup with ice. Strain over a big cube and float the smoky Islay on top.

drinks.name: Rob Roy
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain into a chilled coupe, cherry optional.

drinks.name: Blood and Sand
drinks.steps: Equal parts. Shake with ice, strain into a coupe.

drinks.name: Rusty Nail
drinks.steps: Stir over ice.

drinks.name: Islay Scotch, Neat
drinks.steps: Pour. Add a few drops of water. Smells like a campfire on the sea, which is the point.

drinks.name: Smoky Old Fashioned
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube. Flame the orange peel if you're feeling dramatic.

drinks.name: Hot Toddy
drinks.steps: Stir honey into hot water, add whiskey and lemon. Cinnamon stick. Blanket.

drinks.name: Irish Coffee
drinks.steps: Dissolve sugar in coffee, add whiskey, float the cream on top over the back of a spoon. Do not stir.

drinks.name: Irish Whiskey and Ginger
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Squeeze the lime.

drinks.name: Pint of Stout
drinks.steps: Pour slowly at an angle, let it settle, top it off. Wait for it.

drinks.name: Japanese Highball
drinks.steps: Fill a glass with ice and stir to chill it. Pour off the water, add whisky, stir 13 times, add soda gently, stir once more.

drinks.name: Japanese Whisky, Neat
drinks.steps: Pour. Sip slowly.

drinks.name: Cold Sake
drinks.steps: Chill well. Pour small cups for each other, never for yourself.

drinks.name: Daiquiri
drinks.steps: Shake hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe. No blender.

drinks.name: Hemingway Daiquiri
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain. Drink while writing something sad.

drinks.name: Mojito
drinks.steps: Gently press mint with syrup and lime. Add rum and crushed ice, top with soda, stir up from the bottom.

drinks.name: Mai Tai
drinks.steps: Shake with crushed ice, dump into a glass. Spent lime shell and mint sprig on top.

drinks.name: Zombie
drinks.steps: Blend briefly with crushed ice, pour into a tiki mug. Limit two per guest. Seriously.

drinks.name: Painkiller
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, pour over crushed ice, nutmeg on top.

drinks.name: Pina Colada
drinks.steps: Blend with a cup of ice until smooth. Little umbrella mandatory.

drinks.name: Dark 'n' Stormy
drinks.steps: Ginger beer and lime over ice, float the dark rum on top so it looks like weather.

drinks.name: Hurricane
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into a hurricane glass over fresh ice. Orange wheel, cherry.

drinks.name: Cuba Libre
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Lime wedge. Basically a rum and coke with ambitions.

drinks.name: Planter's Punch
drinks.steps: One of sour, two of sweet, three of strong, four of weak. Stir in a bowl over a block of ice, grate nutmeg on top. Serves the whole band.

drinks.name: Rum Punch Shot
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into a shot glass.

drinks.name: Jungle Bird
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain over fresh ice. Bitter and tropical at the same time.

drinks.name: Aged Rum, Neat
drinks.steps: Pour. Warm the glass in your hand.

drinks.name: Caipirinha
drinks.steps: Muddle lime and sugar hard in the glass. Add cachaca and crushed ice, stir.

drinks.name: Margarita
drinks.steps: Salt half the rim. Shake with ice, strain over fresh ice.

drinks.name: Tommy's Margarita
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain over fresh ice.

drinks.name: Paloma
drinks.steps: Salt and lime in the glass, add tequila and ice, top with grapefruit soda.

drinks.name: Tequila Sunrise
drinks.steps: Tequila and orange juice over ice. Slowly pour the grenadine down the side so it sinks. Don't stir.

drinks.name: Tequila Shot
drinks.steps: Lick, shoot, suck. Make the face.

drinks.name: Ranch Water
drinks.steps: Tequila and lime over ice, top with sparkling mineral water.

drinks.name: Reposado, Neat
drinks.steps: Pour. Sip, don't shoot.

drinks.name: Mezcal Negroni
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube, orange peel.

drinks.name: Oaxaca Old Fashioned
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube. Flame the orange peel over the top.

drinks.name: Naked and Famous
drinks.steps: Equal parts. Shake with ice, strain into a coupe.

drinks.name: Mezcal, Neat with Orange
drinks.steps: Pour. Sip between bites of orange dipped in salt.

drinks.name: Moscow Mule
drinks.steps: Build over ice in a copper mug. Lime wheel.

drinks.name: Cosmopolitan
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into a chilled glass. Flamed orange peel if you're fancy.

drinks.name: Espresso Martini
drinks.steps: Shake very hard with ice so it foams. Strain. Three beans on top.

drinks.name: Bloody Mary
drinks.steps: Roll back and forth between two tins with ice. Pour, garnish with too many things.

drinks.name: White Russian
drinks.steps: Vodka and coffee liqueur over ice. Float the cream. Abide.

drinks.name: Black Russian
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Stir once.

drinks.name: Screwdriver
drinks.steps: Build over ice.

drinks.name: Lemon Drop
drinks.steps: Sugar the rim. Shake with ice, strain.

drinks.name: Sex on the Beach
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Say the name out loud at the bar. Everyone does.

drinks.name: Vodka Soda
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Squeeze the lime. Simple.

drinks.name: Frozen Vodka Shot
drinks.steps: Pour it thick from the freezer. Shoot. Pickle.

drinks.name: Sidecar
drinks.steps: Sugar half the rim. Shake with ice, strain.

drinks.name: Vieux Carre
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube.

drinks.name: Brandy Alexander
drinks.steps: Shake hard with ice, strain, nutmeg on top. Dessert in a glass.

drinks.name: Cognac, Neat
drinks.steps: Pour into a snifter. Swirl. Pretend you own a yacht.

drinks.name: Pisco Sour
drinks.steps: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain, dot the bitters on the foam.

drinks.name: Death in the Afternoon
drinks.steps: Pour absinthe into a flute, slowly top with champagne until it turns milky. Drink three to five slowly.

drinks.name: Absinthe Drip
drinks.steps: Set a sugar cube on a slotted spoon over the glass. Drip ice water through it slowly until the absinthe goes cloudy.

drinks.name: Bijou
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain into a coupe.

drinks.name: Grasshopper
drinks.steps: Shake hard with ice, strain. It is green and that's fine.

drinks.name: Amaretto Sour
drinks.steps: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain over fresh ice.

drinks.name: Aperol Spritz
drinks.steps: Build over lots of ice in a big wine glass. Orange slice.

drinks.name: Americano
drinks.steps: Build over ice, top with soda.

drinks.name: Fernet and Coke
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Tastes like medicine and a good night out.

drinks.name: Fernet Shot
drinks.steps: Shoot it, chase with ginger beer. The bartender's handshake.

drinks.name: Amaro on Ice
drinks.steps: Pour over a big cube. Orange peel.

drinks.name: Jagerbomb
drinks.steps: Drop the shot of Jager into the energy drink. Drink before it stops fizzing. Regret in the morning.

drinks.name: Jager, Ice Cold
drinks.steps: Pour from the freezer. Shoot. Horns up.

drinks.name: Fireball Shot
drinks.steps: Shoot. It burns a little, which is the whole idea.

drinks.name: B-52
drinks.steps: Layer slowly over the back of a spoon in that order. Admire for two seconds. Shoot.

drinks.name: Lemon Drop Shot
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into a sugared shot glass. Bite the lemon.

drinks.name: Pickleback
drinks.steps: Whiskey shot, then pickle brine shot. Trust it.

drinks.name: Slippery Nipple
drinks.steps: Layer the irish cream on top of the sambuca. Shoot. Don't say the name to your mother.

drinks.name: Cheap Lager
drinks.steps: Crack it. Shotgun optional.

drinks.name: Tallboy and a Shot
drinks.steps: Ask for the special. It's always a tallboy and a shot.

drinks.name: IPA
drinks.steps: Pour. Talk about hops if you must.

drinks.name: Hazy Double IPA
drinks.steps: Pour it all into a stemmed glass. It should look like orange juice. Take a photo, apparently.

drinks.name: Pilsner
drinks.steps: Pour with a big foamy head.

drinks.name: Belgian Tripel
drinks.steps: Pour into a chalice, leave the yeast in the bottle.

drinks.name: Sour Beer
drinks.steps: Pour into a tulip glass. Pucker.

drinks.name: Wheat Beer
drinks.steps: Pour most of it, swirl the last bit to get the yeast, pour the rest.

drinks.name: Imperial Stout
drinks.steps: Let it warm up a little. Sip slowly. It's basically a dessert.

drinks.name: Michelada
drinks.steps: Chili-salt the rim. Lime and sauces in the glass over ice, top with beer.

drinks.name: Shandy
drinks.steps: Half and half. Mow a lawn first.

drinks.name: Hard Cider
drinks.steps: Pour over ice or not.

drinks.name: Bottle of Red
drinks.steps: Open. Breathe. Pour.

drinks.name: Cheap Box Wine
drinks.steps: Press the little tap. Don't count.

drinks.name: Natural Orange Wine
drinks.steps: Pour into a tumbler. It's cloudy on purpose.

drinks.name: Rosé
drinks.steps: Ice bucket. Sunshine. Pour.

drinks.name: Crisp White Wine
drinks.steps: Pour cold.

drinks.name: Champagne
drinks.steps: Pop it. Point it away from faces.

drinks.name: Mimosa
drinks.steps: Half and half. Brunch is a valid lifestyle.

drinks.name: Kir Royale
drinks.steps: Cassis in the flute, top with champagne.

drinks.name: Port
drinks.steps: Pour a small glass. Pass to the left.

drinks.name: Mulled Wine
drinks.steps: Warm everything together gently, never boiling, for 20 minutes. Ladle into mugs.

drinks.name: Sangria
drinks.steps: Mix everything except soda in a pitcher, chill for a few hours, top with soda before serving.

drinks.name: Fish House Punch
drinks.steps: Stir in a bowl over a big block of ice. Dangerously smooth. Serves the whole tour bus.

drinks.name: Jungle Juice
drinks.steps: Dump it all in the biggest clean container you can find. Ladle with a red cup.

drinks.name: Pimm's Cup
drinks.steps: Build over ice with the fruit. Tennis optional.

drinks.name: Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.steps: Everything over ice, splash of cola for color. There is no tea. There is only regret.

drinks.name: Blue Lagoon
drinks.steps: Build over ice. It's very blue. That's the point.

drinks.name: Midori Sour
drinks.steps: Shake, strain over ice, splash of soda. Neon green, like a rave flyer.

drinks.name: Electric Lemonade
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Glows under blacklight.

drinks.name: Dreamsicle
drinks.steps: Shake hard with ice, strain. Tastes like a summer afternoon in 1994.

drinks.name: Lavender Gin Fizz
drinks.steps: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain into a glass, slowly top with soda so the foam rises.

drinks.name: Clover Club
drinks.steps: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain. Very pink.

drinks.name: Hanky Panky
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain, orange peel.

drinks.name: Spicy Margarita
drinks.steps: Muddle the jalapeno, shake everything with ice, strain over fresh ice into a tajin-rimmed glass.

drinks.name: Bourbon and Coke
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Classic rock in a glass.

drinks.name: Whiskey and Water
drinks.steps: Half and half. No ice. Sit on the porch.

drinks.name: Moonshine in a Mason Jar
drinks.steps: Unscrew the lid. Pass it around the circle.

drinks.name: Apple Pie Moonshine
drinks.steps: Simmer cider, sugar and cinnamon. Cool completely, then add the moonshine. Jar it up.

drinks.name: Snakebite
ing: blackcurrant cordial (makes it a 'snakebite and black')
drinks.steps: Half lager, half cider. Most UK pubs won't serve it. Drink it anyway.

drinks.name: Kalimotxo
drinks.steps: Half and half over ice. Basque festival classic. Tastes way better than it sounds.

drinks.name: Sherry Cobbler
drinks.steps: Shake with orange slices and ice, pour over crushed ice, pile berries on top, use a straw.

drinks.name: Bamboo
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain, lemon twist. Low in alcohol, high in class.

drinks.name: Sake Bomb
drinks.steps: Balance the shot on chopsticks across the beer. Pound the table. It drops. Chug.

drinks.name: Soju and Yakult
drinks.steps: Mix in a pitcher with ice. Sweet, tangy, dangerous.

drinks.name: Soju Shot
drinks.steps: Twist and flick the cap off. Pour for your elders with two hands. Turn away to drink.

drinks.name: Ouzo on Ice
drinks.steps: Add water and watch it cloud. Ice after, not before.

drinks.name: Aquavit and Beer
drinks.steps: Skål. Shot, then a long pull of beer.

drinks.name: Pisco Punch
drinks.steps: Mix in a bowl over a block of ice with the pineapple cubes.

drinks.name: Hot Buttered Rum
drinks.steps: Stir the batter into hot water until melted, add the rum. Fireplace.

drinks.name: Eggnog
drinks.steps: Whisk yolks and sugar, add dairy and booze, fold in whipped whites. Rest overnight. Nutmeg.

drinks.name: Spiked Hot Cocoa
drinks.steps: Stir the booze into the cocoa. Marshmallows on top.

drinks.name: Smoke and Mirrors
drinks.steps: Rinse a coupe with absinthe. Shake the rest hard and double strain in.

drinks.name: Black Manhattan
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain into a chilled coupe. Brandied cherry.

drinks.name: Trinidad Sour
drinks.steps: Yes, a whole ounce and a half of bitters. Shake with ice, strain.

drinks.name: Black Velvet
drinks.steps: Champagne first, then float the stout on top. Invented to mourn a prince. Fitting.

drinks.name: Red Wine, Very Dark
drinks.steps: Pour into a goblet. Light the candle. Turn off everything else.

drinks.name: Cherry Bomb
drinks.steps: Drop the shot into the energy drink. Eat the cherry.

drinks.name: Hugo Spritz
drinks.steps: Gently press the mint in the glass, add ice and everything else.

drinks.name: Elderflower Collins
drinks.steps: Build over ice, top with soda, cucumber ribbon.

drinks.name: Chartreuse Swizzle
drinks.steps: Swizzle with crushed ice until the glass frosts. Grated nutmeg and mint.

drinks.name: Garibaldi
drinks.steps: Blend the orange juice until it's frothy, pour over campari on ice.

drinks.name: Gin Rickey
drinks.steps: Build over ice. Bone dry and very refreshing.

drinks.name: Spaghett
drinks.steps: Drink a couple of sips off the top. Pour in the Aperol and lemon. Done.

drinks.name: Bitter Giuseppe
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube, lemon peel.

drinks.name: Kamikaze Shot
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain into shot glasses. Make a few.

drinks.name: Dublin Drop
drinks.steps: Drop the layered shot into the half pint of stout and chug before it curdles.

drinks.name: Bloody Caesar
drinks.steps: Rim the glass with celery salt. Build over ice, stir, lime wedge. Tastes like the ocean got into a fight.

drinks.name: Bloody Maria
drinks.steps: Roll between two tins with ice, pour into a glass. Pickled jalapeño on top.

drinks.name: Vampiro
drinks.steps: Chili-salt the rim. Build over ice and top with grapefruit soda.

drinks.name: Red Eye
drinks.steps: Tomato juice in the glass, top with beer. The egg is between you and your god.

drinks.name: Blood Orange Negroni
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube. Blood orange wheel.

drinks.name: Corn 'n' Oil
drinks.steps: Build over ice, stir. Black as motor oil, which is the name.

drinks.name: Rum Old Fashioned
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain over a large cube, orange peel.

drinks.name: Ti' Punch
drinks.steps: Squeeze the lime coin into the glass, add syrup and rhum, stir. Ice optional. Everyone makes their own.

drinks.name: Toronto
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain into a chilled coupe, orange peel.

drinks.name: Brooklyn
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain into a chilled coupe.

drinks.name: Final Ward
drinks.steps: Equal parts. Shake with ice, strain into a coupe.

drinks.name: Rattlesnake
drinks.steps: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain. The absinthe is the bite.

drinks.name: Diamondback
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain into a chilled coupe. Strong. Respect it.

drinks.name: Midnight Stinger
drinks.steps: Shake with ice, strain over crushed ice, mint sprig.

drinks.name: Bobby Burns
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain, lemon peel. Recite poetry if you must.

drinks.name: Blackthorn
drinks.steps: Stir with ice, strain into a coupe. Named after a thorny hedge with black berries.

drinks.name: Kopstootje
drinks.steps: Fill the tulip glass to the very brim. Bend down, sip without touching it. Then the beer. A 'little headbutt'.

drinks.name: Mezcal Sour
drinks.steps: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain, dot bitters on the foam.

drinks.name: Absinthe Frappé
drinks.steps: Shake absinthe, syrup and mint with ice, strain over crushed ice, top with a little soda.

drinks.name: Chartreuse, Ice Cold
drinks.steps: Pour from the freezer into a tiny glass. 130 herbs, made by monks, recipe secret. Fitting.

drinks.name: Black Death
drinks.steps: Iceland's caraway schnapps. Shoot it cold. The fish is traditional and not optional.

drinks.name: Salmiakki Shot
drinks.steps: Shake the bottle, pour cold, shoot. Salty, black, Finnish.

drinks.name: Unicum Shot
drinks.steps: Hungary's bitter herbal medicine. Shoot it. Feel your soul leave and come back.

drinks.name: Malört Shot
drinks.steps: Chicago's wormwood punishment. Shoot it, make the face, chase it with beer.

drinks.name: Becherovka and Tonic
drinks.steps: Build over ice. The Czechs call it a 'beton'.

drinks.name: Rauchbier
drinks.steps: Pour into a stein. It tastes like a campfire. You'll be on your third before you notice.

drinks.name: Baltic Porter
drinks.steps: Pour, let it warm a few degrees. Strong and black, brewed for northern winters.

drinks.name: Barleywine
ing: barleywine, aged a year if you can wait
drinks.steps: Small pour into a snifter. Sip like a whisky. It's about as strong as wine.

drinks.name: Gløgg
drinks.steps: Warm everything except the aquavit gently for 30 minutes. Add the aquavit at the end. Spoon raisins and almonds into each mug.

drinks.name: Fernet Flip
drinks.steps: Dry shake hard, then shake with ice. Strain, nutmeg on top. Bitter eggnog for weirdos.
